reporting.lead_count_basis: Open opportunities across all three pipelines: 176 in (1) PROJECT: Lead Qualification, 23 in (2) PROJECT: Sales Pipeline, 51 in STORE: Material Pipeline.

exclusions._comment: Reconciles the netted metrics back to raw. Excluded records are not dropped; they stay in conversations[] / new_leads[] carrying the flag that excluded them.
exclusions.unanswered_note: No conversations today were pure noise (unnamed missed calls with no voicemail, or 'We've Moved' style automated logs) — every thread scored as 'us owe a response' had a genuine name/history behind it, so nothing nets out today. This is a valid quiet outcome, not a check that was skipped.
exclusions.drift_excluded_note: 9 contacts hold call-queue with no lead: tag, all in 0a. New Lead, which drift_excluded_stages suppresses from findings (the untagged_in_queue metric still reports the live queue depth). Separately, 112 opportunities in 0b. Far Out (Cold) are tagged lead: cold and past 75% of the 90-day threshold — suppressed by the conditional exclusion, including a 94-record cohort that all share an identical ~307-day lastStageChangeAt consistent with an Oct 2025 bulk stage migration, not 94 individual stage entries.

leads_by_source._comment: opportunity.source across the two PROJECT pipelines' 199 open opportunities (STORE: Material Pipeline tracked separately in store_stage_counts).

leads_by_tag._comment: Tag breakdown across the 199 currently-open (1) PROJECT: Lead Qualification + (2) PROJECT: Sales Pipeline opportunities — where the lead: qualification tags live per the workflow. STORE: Material Pipeline does not use these tags.

store_stage_counts._comment: STORE: Material Pipeline, open (status=open) opportunities per stage. 17 records sit in the two 'Closed' stage names while status is still open — a stage/status divergence worth cleaning up, same as noted in the 2026-08-31 run.

avg_days_in_stage._comment: 0b. Far Out (Cold) is skewed by a 94-record cohort sharing one ~307-day lastStageChangeAt (bulk migration); excluding it the stage average is roughly 118 days.

opportunity_status_counts._comment: Lifetime totals across all three pipelines. Abandoned remains by far the largest bucket, as expected.

reporting.store_pipeline_note: STORE: Material Pipeline holds 51 open opportunities and had 0 new wins in the last 24h (6 lifetime wins checked, most recent June 30). Retail material sales, distinct from project work, running its own +3d/+8d cadence. No stale thresholds are defined for this pipeline, so no staleness prediction is made for it.

stale_thresholds_used._comment: Echoed from platform-settings/ghl-workflow.json so a threshold change shows up in the diff.

meeting_window_summary._comment: The window any new Meeting-scheduled follow-up sequence must fit inside. The 30-day threshold counts from stage entry, so appointments booked far out shrink the usable runway.
meeting_window_summary.note: 20 of 21 Meeting-scheduled contacts were matched to a booked appointment by pulling calendar events for Pourya and Albert (Apr 1 - Sep 1) and joining on contactId. The one unmatched is John Ap Disposal, whose contact record carries no tags at all and may not be a real customer appointment.

data_quality_notes: 94 of 119 open 0b. Far Out (Cold) opportunities share one identical lastStageChangeAt (~Oct 29 2025, ~307 days ago), consistent with a bulk stage migration. Their day counts are not real per-lead staleness; all 94 are tagged lead: cold and suppressed via the conditional exclusion rather than reported as 94 individual findings.

Biplab Ghosh (contact 9et4LUnHmetxVT1xRep3) has two simultaneous open opportunities: one in *Meeting (Scheduled)* CCAM|GHL (cancelled appointment, $5,182) and one in 0b. Far Out (Cold) — worth reconciling into one record.

opportunities_search-opportunity has no updated-at sort or filter, so pipeline moves/closes in the window were found by pulling every open record in each thresholded stage and filtering on lastStageChangeAt, plus paging the two PROJECT pipelines' 'won' status (302 + 6 records) sorted by createdAt to check lastStatusChangeAt. A full sweep of 'lost'/'abandoned' closes in the window was not performed (236 + 1,302 lifetime records, no way to sort by recency) — if any closed today via those paths it would not appear in pipeline_moves.

Mukesh H Patel and Bash Saqr, both flagged untagged/stale in yesterday's (2026-08-31) run, are resolved today: Mukesh now carries lead: cold, and Bash Saqr no longer appears in any open thresholded stage.

17 STORE: Material Pipeline records sit in the '6a. Closed - Won' / '6b. Closed - Lost' stage names while opportunity status is still 'open' — a stage/status divergence, same as flagged in the 2026-08-31 run.
